bio: My name is Zach and I’m a J.D. student at Harvard Law School. I am originally from Lubsko, Poland, but have now spent a good chunk of time in Cambridge. having graduated from the College in May 2024 with an A.B. in German and Government, and an A.M. in German. I’m an avid moviegoer, espresso aficionado, and a language learning enthusiast. Always happy to talk! Community Yards Ivy Yard Area Proctors Role Proctors
